subject: Re: MAP + security gates — SOC 2 / SIG/CAIQ / DPA & retention (Capitol Bank)
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@capitolbank.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@capitolbank.com>, security@capitolbank.com
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff + security gate clarifications

Hi Mateo —

Thanks for the demo yesterday. We want to formalize the mutual action plan (MAP) so our InfoSec and procurement teams can sign off. A few immediate asks from security/procurement: 

- SOC 2: we need the latest SOC 2 Type II report and a short bulleted summary of the control coverage relevant to customer data access.
- SIG/CAIQ: do you have completed SIG answers or a CAIQ export we can review?
- DPA: proposed redlines we should expect on data processing, subprocessor list, and deletion/return clauses.
- Data retention: Capitol requires a default retention of 7 years for transaction logs and 1 year for ephemeral logs; we need to know where data is stored and options for US-only residency.

Can you share a MAP draft with security milestones and target dates? We're trying to align a July->August evaluation run with a procurement decision by end of August.

Appreciate a concise handoff doc so I can share with Marta (procurement) and our SOC team.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Integrations — Capitol Bank
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@capitolbank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + security gate clarifications

Samir —

Great to connect. Attached is a first-pass MAP and an evidence packet: MAP_CapitolBank_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones), SOC2_summary.pdf (summary + control scope), and Data_Retention_Table.csv (residency/options). High-level answers below; I put proposed target dates in the MAP sheet.

SOC 2
- We will provide the latest SOC 2 Type II report under NDA; summary highlights included in the PDF (encryption at-rest & in-transit, key management, access reviews, incident response).

SIG/CAIQ
- We maintain a CAIQ export for our current platform version and can share a completed SIG matrix. Redactions only for internal ticket IDs.

DPA & Subprocessors
- We have a standard DPA with limited redlines: deletion upon termination, subprocessors list and 30-day notice for new subprocessors, and a clause for audit rights. We can accept a carveout for EU data residency if required.

Data Retention & Residency
- Default retention options we support: transaction logs up to 7 years (configurable), ephemeral debug logs up to 90 days by default (can extend).
- Residency: US-only (multi-region within US), EU-only, and hybrid options available for Dedicated/Private deployments. For Hosted we offer US-East and US-West regional controls and customer-managed KMS for keys.

Proposed MAP timeline (in brief)
- 7/19: Share MAP + initial attachments (sent)
- 7/22: Security intake call (30–45m) to review SOC2 summary & SIG matrix
- 7/29–8/12: Evidence sprint (we'll tag owners and deliverable links)
- 8/19: Final security acceptance or carveouts list
- 8/25: Procurement finalization / signature target

If that aligns, I'll book the security intake call for Friday 7/22 and include Neha (Security PM) and Laura (Legal ops) to help with evidence and DPA redlines respectively.

Attachment stubs:
- MAP_CapitolBank_v1.xlsx (sheet: milestones, owners, deliverables)
- SOC2_summary.pdf (2pp executive summary + scope)
- Data_Retention_Table.csv (row per data class; residency options & default retention)

—
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@capitolbank.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 15:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + security gate clarifications

Samir / Mateo —

Thanks — quick clarifications from the security side before the intake call so we can prep the right artifacts: 

1) Audit window: Capitol asked for 7 years for transaction logs — we can support this as an option, but need to align on which log classes (write-audit, read-audit, system traces). Can you confirm that the ask is for all transaction-level logs or only financial transaction traces?

2) SIG scope: will Capitol want completed answers against the latest CAIQ (v3) or a subset? If a subset, please flag the priority domains (e.g., Data Security, Infrastructure, Business Continuity).

3) DPA redlines: Laura, would you like procurement to propose specific wording on deletion vs. anonymization for escrowed backups?

I'm pasting the MAP milestones we proposed below (excerpt) so Samir/Marta can see owners / example deliverables: 

--- EXCERPT FROM MAP_CapitolBank_v1.xlsx ---
Milestone: Security intake call — Owner: Mateo — Deliverable: SOC2_summary.pdf + CAIQ export (read-only) — Target: 2028-07-22
Milestone: Evidence sprint week 1 — Owner: Neha — Deliverable: sample configs, KV rotation logs, infra diagram — Target: 2028-07-29
Milestone: DPA redlines review — Owner: Laura — Deliverable: annotated DPA (redline) — Target: 2028-08-05
--- END EXCERPT ---

We'll keep the evidence artifacts in a shared Drive link and provide HubSpot references for each deliverable. If Capitol can confirm the log classes and SIG priority domains ahead of the call it will speed the sprint.

Neha Kapoor
Security PM | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
From: Samir Patel <samir@capitolbank.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 19 Jul 2028 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + security gate clarifications

Team —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the MAP draft. That timeline looks workable. Quick answers: 

- Log classes: primary ask is for financial transaction traces (transaction-level audit trail) for 7 years; system debug traces can remain at 1 year.
- SIG/CAIQ: we need the full CAIQ export (v3) for the initial review; we'll flag priority domains during the intake call.
- DPA: procurement prefers explicit deletion language for backups where feasible; we'll mark exceptions where regulatory retention applies.

Please send the Drive link with the evidence pack and a DocuSign-ready DPA when Laura's redlines are incorporated. Marta and I will be on the intake call Friday.

Samir Patel
Head of Integrations — Capitol Bank
